definitions.unit: unique review, not a vehicle or owner; topic statistics count each review once per topic
definitions.shares: fractions from 0 to 1; model/country/engine_type maps use all reviews of this topic as denominator
definitions.sentiment: inherited from stage 1; AI does not reclassify reviews or change counts
definitions.neutral: explicit neutral only; undetermined is never silently converted to neutral
definitions.global_sentiment: each original review counted once; combine all its fragments, including fragments without a topic
definitions.negative_rate: negative reviews / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.negative_or_mixed_rate: (negative + mixed reviews) / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.share_of_all_topic_negative_reviews: negative reviews in this segment / negative reviews in the entire topic
definitions.topic_prevalence_in_source_segment: reviews in this topic and segment / all original reviews in this segment
definitions.country_engine_type: joint counts, not products of independent marginal shares
definitions.signals: descriptive comparisons, not causal findings or multiple-testing-adjusted significance results

overview.summary: Across this G70 corpus, sentiment is led by praise for driving dynamics, ride comfort, quietness, interior and exterior design, and technology appeal, while complaints concentrate on control and interface usability, connectivity and software issues, climate performance, dealership or service handling, and recurring feature malfunctions, with many service-style fragments remaining sentiment-undetermined.
limitations: A large share of the corpus is undetermined because many fragments are short service notes, procedural records, or incomplete statements without clear evaluative context.
Topics overlap, so they should not be added together or treated as independent counts.
Several clusters mix unrelated subjects or contain label-example mismatches, especially in service-note and keyword-driven topics, which limits how specifically they can be interpreted.
The corpus is overwhelmingly from one country segment, so smaller country segments provide insufficient examples for reliable comparison.
Some topic evidence reflects dealership, diagnostic, or administrative language rather than direct owner opinions about the vehicle experience.
